phase_name: SCOPE 7 -- provenance adjudication for the three newly ingested documents

objectives.description: Manual spot-check gate: open and read a chunk from each of the three documents
Confirm chunk counts still match index (85/82/199)
Set provenance_fidelity, path, token_count on all three entries
Verify sub-index fidelity narrative intact and consistent

manual_spot_check_records.verdict: Prose narrative coherent and readable (definitions, Boolean-algebra discussion follow logically); mathematical formulas visibly degraded by OCR (garbled tuple notation 'W <A, +P 0, 1,,-', mangled symbols 'REP', 'Ame1', 'IH', truncated Definition 1.1) -- confirms the sub-index's PROSE-high/FORMULAS-DEGRADED narrative independently.

Same symptom independently confirmed on Part II: prose narrative (proof about relation algebras) reads coherently, but formula notation is garbled ('<A, u, A, n, V, 1, I, -\'>' for a tuple, 'F(x) ==E [for some u U...]', misrendered equals signs and subscripts).

Both prose and mathematical symbols render cleanly (proper Unicode: Mp∨Fp∨Pp, M¬Mp→¬Mp, Γ|=α, {δ}∪{ψ(γ):γ∈Γ}|=ψ(α)); no degradation observed across two independently sampled chunks -- confirms the sub-index's PROSE-and-SYMBOLS-good narrative.

audit_corroboration.result: The audit's output does NOT cover any of the three documents. Root cause confirmed by the script's own header comment: literature-fidelity-audit.sh only scans directories under sources/<dir>/; these three documents were ingested via the online-ingest bridge with chunks_dir directly under LITERATURE_DIR (not sources/), so the script never matches or writes them. No automated corroboration was available for any of the three -- the manual read is the sole evidence, consistent with the plan's design (manual read is primary, audit is corroboration-only when available).

verification_notes.search_verification: literature-search.sh --include-unverified returns hits for all three documents (confirmed for both Jonsson-Tarski and Goldblatt queries). Default (non---include-unverified) search does NOT return them, and reports their provenance_fidelity as 'unverified_summary' rather than the true stamped value -- see new_code_level_finding below.

new_code_level_finding: literature-search.sh's load_fidelity_map() (search script, not the fidelity-audit script) hard-codes an assumption that any provenance_fidelity-bearing entry has a path starting with the literal prefix 'sources/' (see its own docstring: keyed by directory name extracted via path[len('sources/'):].split('/',1)[0]). The three SCOPE 7 entries' real chunks_dir/path is directly under LITERATURE_DIR (a legacy online-ingest bridge location, not sources/), so their path (correctly set to the real, honest location per SCOPE 1's directory-path convention) does not start with 'sources/' and load_fidelity_map() silently skips them, fail-opening get_fidelity() to 'unverified_summary' for all three -- including the Goldblatt entry, which is genuinely verified_conversion and should NOT be quarantined from default search ranking. This is a CODE-level defect (matching the pattern of the five already-known code defects the plan's Overview places out of scope in the global agent-system repo), not a DATA defect -- fixing it would require either moving the physical source directories under sources/ (a filesystem reorganization beyond this plan's Non-Goals 'edits index metadata only') or changing literature-search.sh's lookup logic (agent-system code, explicitly out of scope per the plan's Non-Goals). Recorded here rather than fixed; recommend a follow-up meta/code task to widen load_fidelity_map()'s dirname-extraction to also recognize online-ingest-bridge (non-sources/) paths, mirroring whatever fix is eventually applied to literature-fidelity-audit.sh's equivalent sources/-only restriction.
